Mew is a Psychic-type Pokémon with high stats.[[13]](#cite_note-guide-13) Morimoto designed it as a pale pink [feliform](/wiki/Feliform "Feliform") creature with somewhat large eyes and a long, thin tail that broadens at the end,[[14]](#cite_note-biography-14) though the shiny version is blue and rarely distributed.[[15]](#cite_note-15) Mew was primarily designed off of its in-universe clone, [Mewtwo](/wiki/Mewtwo "Mewtwo"). It was designed as a simpler version of Mewtwo, being visually much smaller in terms of both size and sprite, with less detail on its body, so it would take up less space in the game's data.[[12]](#cite_note-:1-12) Mew was not shown moving until [the first movie](/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon:_The_First_Movie "Pokémon: The First Movie"), and thus it had no behaviors and personality outlined yet.
